  "pros": [
    "Comprehensive features for tracking sales and projects.",
    "Good value for the price, especially for a small team.",
    "Centralized place for customer interaction logs."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial learning curve felt steep for a new user.",
    "Interface can sometimes feel a bit cluttered.",
    "Customization for specific marketing-related projects took effort."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This SEO Executive found Zoho CRM to be a functional tool for managing sales opportunities, project progress, and customer interactions within their small capital markets company. While appreciating its comprehensive feature set and good value, they experienced some initial challenges with ease of use and navigating the extensive interface. The platform effectively centralized their tracking needs but required effort to fully adapt to their specific workflow."
